scope: Preserve V8U through V9J, close the S355 pair at descriptive-comparator status, and screen primary government, institutional or official solver sources for at most one bounded open high-rate impact benchmark. Selection requires a downloadable solver deck or otherwise reconstructible model definition, measured validation outputs, explicit failure or regularization treatment, exact provenance and a declared convergence observable. V9K performs no solver run, material fit or WTC/CF6 substitution.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A repository record, license, source file, report statement, table or figure from a primary authoritative source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A reported government or official-solver benchmark result; not reproduced by V9K.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No WTC archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The seven all-or-nothing selection gates and later 10 percent convergence threshold.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Per-candidate gate statuses, rejection reasons and zero-or-one selection decision.
evidence_policy.unknown: Any model field, measurement, license or convergence evidence absent from the inspected primary sources.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.reason: No LS-DYNA deck or complete CAD/mesh definition is listed, and the full rig cannot be deterministically reconstructed from report figures alone.

candidate_matrix.title: Altair RD-E 2602 Ductile Failure Model - ruptured plate

lawful_open_access_and_license.reason: The files are publicly downloadable, but the inspected page states All Rights Reserved and no explicit reusable deck license was identified.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.reason: The official page declares a small downloadable input ZIP for the complete example.

failure_and_regularization_complete.reason: Failure parameters and deletion options are shown, but no characteristic length, nonlocal formulation or objective fracture-energy regularization is documented.

measured_validation_outputs.reason: The example is a numerical feature demonstration with no experimental measurement comparator.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.reason: No three-level mesh study or declared converged impact observable is supplied.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.reason: The small official Radioss example is compatible with the installed OpenRadioss solver and is expected to be bounded, although V9K does not execute it.

controlling_rejection_reasons: The files are publicly downloadable, but the inspected page states All Rights Reserved and no explicit reusable deck license was identified.
Failure parameters and deletion options are shown, but no characteristic length, nonlocal formulation or objective fracture-energy regularization is documented.
The example is a numerical feature demonstration with no experimental measurement comparator.
No three-level mesh study or declared converged impact observable is supplied.

interpretation: V9K validates a negative primary-source screening result. NASA provides relevant physical impact regimes but not reconstructible models or converged quantitative validation; FAA DOT/FAA/TC-14/43 documents material and mesh sensitivity severe enough to change fragmentation and requires long proprietary LS-DYNA runs; Altair RD-E 2602 is executable but is a rigid-projectile numerical feature example without measured validation, objective fracture regularization or a convergence study. No candidate satisfies all seven gates, so no benchmark, material substitution, rupture run, facade run or global WTC inference is authorized.
